errors.text_span: с равномерно разположени етикети на всеки две години
errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are not uniformly spaced every two years. The labels are for 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, and 2021. The last interval, from 2020 to 2021, is one year.
The line starts at a value close to 0.1 million for the year 2010, not 0.5 million.
The line ends at a value just below 7 million for the year 2021 (approximately 6.8 million), not 7.5 million.
